dedupe_keys.name: luxembourg drinking water infrastructure layers from the water management administration 753 reservoirs 867 abstraction points public water points and water and wastewater syndicates

description: The Luxembourg Water Management Administration (Administration de la gestion de l'eau) publishes its drinking water infrastructure layers through the national geoportal and the open data portal. Contents: 753 drinking water reservoirs with station code and name; 867 drinking water abstraction points (boreholes, springs and surface intakes) with station codes; 155 public drinking water fountains; the service areas of drinking water syndicates and of wastewater syndicates by commune; and the source of drinking water per commune (own resources, external resources or supply from a syndicate); related layers give provisional and regulated drinking water protection zones, including those around the Esch-sur-Sûre reservoir. Producer: the Water Management Administration, with the geoportal of the Administration du cadastre et de la topographie as publisher. Coverage: the whole of Luxembourg. Format and access: shapefile, GeoPackage and GeoJSON downloads refreshed monthly on data.public.lu, an OGC API Features service (features.geoportail.lu) and WMS; metadata sits in the geocatalogue. Licence: Creative Commons CC0. Caveats: pipes and treatment works are not published; attributes are limited to codes and names, so capacities must come from utility reports. Simulation uses: mapping the supply chain from abstraction to storage for water system resilience, drought and contamination scenarios, and exposure of wells and reservoirs to floods. Related records: the Luxembourg flood and heavy rainfall hazard maps (data-luxembourg-flood-and-heavy-rainfall-hazard-maps) support exposure analysis.
